events.title: From the Snowfields to the Void: A Look at the Ten Expedition Maps in Endless Va
events.summary: Hello, everyone! Endless Valkyrie is in the final stages of preparation for release. Today, we’d like to show you one of the most important parts of the adventure: the expedition maps.The game features ten maps, each with its own theme. Your journey begins in the Frozen Wastes, Crystal Caverns, and Castle Ruins, then continues through places such as the Ashen Wasteland, Misty Swamp, and Thunder Gorge before reaching the Void Frontier.
